name: Immersive Firewood: Peat & Deadwood
description: Dug peat seasons in place over a season into a cheap, cool bulk fuel that fills a shed and heats a room for hours - it never gets hot enough to cook meat or bread. Adds fallen deadwood logs for day-one scavenging, restores driftwood splitting, and gives Immersive Firewood per-species seasoning and burn-temperature curves so soft, fast-growing wood becomes the hot preheating fuel and hardwood the long steady burn. Recommends Drying Speed Overhaul.
